payload.thirtySeconds: Dan94 won net and gross at Arcadia Bluffs, because apparently somebody had to be the adult in the room while the rest of the field was sanding drywall. MattF was the closest net threat, but Dan94 still beat him by three and kept the underlying ball-striking profile that’s been dragging him toward the top all rolling cycle.
payload.latestTournamentTeaser: Dan94 cashes in at Arcadia while everyone else auditions for net damage
payload.stateOfLeague: This keeps Dan94’s profile looking like a real headliner, not a one-week weather report. MattF and KeithK75 both remain dangerous enough to sniff wins, but the field’s also reminding everybody that brutal holes and sloppy short games can still torch a card fast.
